title: AS2: loadMovie/loadMovieNum push url and target in wrong order for ActionGetURL2
description: In packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts, the handlers for loadMovie(url, target) and loadMovieNum(url, level) push url and target onto the stack in the wrong order for ActionGetURL2 (0x9F per avm1/opcode.rs). ActionGetURL2 pops: window/target first (bottom), then url (top). So the correct push order is: push target FIRST (deeper), push url LAST (top). If the compiler pushes url first and target second, ActionGetURL2 sees them swapped and navigates to the wrong URL. Fix: verify the push order in the loadMovie/loadMovieNum handler and swap if needed. Cross-reference ruffle/swf/src/avm1/read.rs read_get_url_2 and opcode.rs.
